Based on the flow data I’ve seen, the US appears to be changing the strategy a bit in regards to the Oman Lane transits. 

Instead of focusing on steady volumes day in and day out, which exhausts a lot of resources. 

They are escorting tankers going in and out in clusters. 

This might work initially, but once Iran catches up, it just makes this strategy more dangerous. 

I guess we will see.
